d.title: Sekai de Ichiban Tsuyoku Naritai!
d.en: Wanna Be the Strongest in the World
d.jp: 世界でいちばん強くなりたい!
d.synopsis: Hagiwara Sakura and Miyazawa Elena are the leading members of a popular idol group, Sweet Diva. One day, Elena is injured by the attack of a female pro-wrestler Kazama Rio during the recording of a TV program. Sakura gets mad at Rio and gives her a dropkick. To avenge Elena, Sakura enters the female pro-wrestling matches.

rel.name: Sekai de Ichiban Tsuyoku Naritai! Specials
